pi_source_verified_contracts.contract: Adapters constructed with the same storage object use a WeakMap-shared SerialQueue.
A transaction holds that queue while its storage.transaction callback settles, then invalidates the transaction handle in finally.
Direct storage calls bypass the queue. The committed test adds a direct host write while a transaction is suspended and verifies both writes roll back after abort.
pi_source_verified_contracts.test: includes direct underlying calls in an active transaction

pi_source_verified_contracts.contract: The committed test queues a second adapter operation behind the failed transaction and expects only that queued write to survive.
pi_source_verified_contracts.test: runs operations from another adapter after a transaction, outside its rollback

pi_dependency_boundary.adapter_primitives: SerialQueue, DurableObjectSqliteExecutor, DurableObjectSqliteTransaction, and DurableObjectSqliteDatabase use standard JavaScript plus a structurally typed storage object; they never call SqliteStorage.
pi_dependency_boundary.factory_boundary: Only openDurableObjectSqliteStorage invokes SqliteStorage.open. Loading the complete module normally still loads ./storage.ts.
pi_dependency_boundary.upstream_test_stand_in_host_behavior: Node DatabaseSync implements BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK; SQL cursor wrapper exposes next()/toArray(); ArrayBuffer bindings/results are converted to/from Uint8Array.
pi_dependency_boundary.source_review_scope: Static inspection of the pinned adapter and upstream test imports; the separately recorded limited_adapter_execution is the actual local run.

openclaw_selected_fix_interpretation: 105f2db changes a repeated consume-native-subagent-assignment with undelivered=true and changed.absent=true into a successful retirement result, after existing owner/authority matching code has run.
Its persistent test expects a repeated same-owner retirement to return true, an altered lifecycle owner to return false, and exercises database close/reset/reopen helpers.
Its Doctor repair change requires a real canonical fingerprint before ownership inspection, with tests for number, absent, and empty fingerprint values.
The code/test patch was read, not executed by this worker. Broader end-to-end upgrade behavior is still unverified.

verifiers_source_verified_contracts.finding: Error.details holds structured diagnostics. Error.from_exception reuses the record attached to the exception; the record does not store exception/traceback-frame objects.
record_error appends only if the exact Error record identity is not already present, then marks failure.
A caught scoring exception gets Error.details with attempt, changed info and metrics, is appended and notified, then may be retried/rethrown. Failed partial scores/state are not committed to trace.
Persistent added regression manually appends an Error with details and checks delta reconstruction equals trace.errors. It does not drive grade_task retries or timeout paths.

verifiers_timeout_static_assessment.classification: Source-supported semantic concern; no upstream code execution or end-to-end reproduction

code_path.observation: Expired shared scoring deadline throws TimeoutError inside the catch-all attempt boundary, which appends an Error record before retry/rethrow.
The caller catches grade_task TimeoutError, records scoring timeout, and only calls fail when on_score is set. At finalization trace.ok is set to not _failed.
record_timeout sets is_timeout and stop condition without appending errors or changing ok; last_error returns errors[-1].

verifiers_timeout_static_assessment.implication: In the no-on_score timeout route, the new append may leave a timeout-stopped successful trace with a last_error. Whether this matches the intended public contract needs maintainer judgment and genuine runtime tests.
